header.title: WordPress
header.subtitle: Connect your agent to WordPress with the official plugin or embed code

embed.description: Paste embed code into WordPress without the plugin — use a Custom HTML block, WPCode footer snippet, or your theme footer.
embed.iframeHint: Add a Custom HTML block on a page and paste this iframe for an inline chat section.
embed.floatingHint: Paste in Settings → Insert Headers and Footers (footer) or WPCode to show a floating bubble site-wide.

install.intro: Follow these steps to connect WordPress using the official Anselio plugin. For manual embed without the plugin, use the Embed code tab.
install.configureAfter: . Paste your Anselio App URL, Agent ID, and widget token (if shown on Setup). Choose
install.saveBody: Visit your site’s front end (not the admin). You should see the chat bubble or shortcode embed.
install.withoutPluginAfter: (or similar), paste the floating snippet from the Embed code tab into the footer, or use a Custom HTML block for inline iframe embeds.
install.troubleshootingAfter: in the Anselio repository for troubleshooting.

setup.disabled: Enable WordPress deployment using the switch above to configure the plugin and embed code.
setup.prerequisitesDescription: WordPress embeds your hosted chat widget. Enable the chat widget and make the agent public and active so visitors can chat.
setup.widgetWarning: Turn on the chat widget before embedding on WordPress.
setup.officialPluginDescription: Download the Anselio plugin, then paste these values under Settings → Anselio in WordPress.
setup.appUrlDescription: Your Anselio dashboard origin (no trailing slash).
setup.widgetTokenDescription: Required for private agents — copy from your agent security settings if needed.
setup.widgetTokenNotRequired: Not required for public agents without a widget token.
setup.embedUrlDescription: Full iframe URL — used by the plugin and manual embed snippets.

embed.pageLinkDescription: Share this URL so customers can open your standalone help page. Append
embed.embedDescription: Or embed the help page on your site. Branding comes from your saved settings.

navigation.title: Sidebar navigation
navigation.info: Buttons shown in the help page sidebar. Primary uses a filled style.
navigation.description: Add links for your customers (e.g. docs, pricing). Opens in a new tab.

settings.headline: Headline
settings.headlineDescription: Large text above the chat input on the help page.
settings.faviconDescription: ICO, PNG, or SVG up to 1MB. Shown in the browser tab.
settings.themeSwitchDescription: Let visitors toggle between light and dark mode.
settings.voiceToTextDescription: Show a microphone button in the chat input. Speech is transcribed into the message field.
settings.logoDescription: Shown in the sidebar on light backgrounds. JPG, PNG, or SVG up to 1MB.
settings.darkLogoDescription: Shown in the sidebar on dark backgrounds.
settings.heroImageDescription: Centered above the headline on light backgrounds.
settings.darkHeroImageDescription: Centered above the headline on dark backgrounds.
